action.objective: Retreat bishop to d2, keeping material intact and king safe; expand on the queenside.
action.rationale: e3d2 is the only commit_ready_move: verified at effective depth 4 with exact +53, safety complete (no mate-in-one), tactical_refutation not_found. It retreats the bishop from f5's pressure line, keeps it on a useful diagonal (c1-d2-e3-f4, attacking c3/e1/f4), and does not hang material to Rxh4. No other candidate has verification and analysis nodes are exhausted (analysis_nodes_available 0). Rxh4 by Black wins a pawn but h4 is expendable and no forced tactic follows.
